items.title: Introducing AI Futures
items.summary: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.

items.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
items.summary: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.summary: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

items.summary: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe
items.summary: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.summary: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

items.summary: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.

items.title: How NVIDIA scales expertise with ChatGPT Work
items.summary: NVIDIA teams use ChatGPT Work to reduce manual tasks, connect fast-moving signals, and scale successful workflows globally.

items.title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
items.summary: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.
